n4f7a05928f.headline: CBE maintains overnight deposit and lending rates
n4f7a05928f.summary: The Central Bank of Egypt's Monetary Policy Committee kept its overnight deposit and lending rates unchanged, with its main operation rate held at 27.75%. The decision was made at a Thursday meeting.
n4f7a05928f.why: Interest rates set by the central bank shape borrowing costs, bond yields and the currency's attractiveness to foreign investors. Egypt's policy rate is a key benchmark for its local debt markets.

n27424e9463.headline: Iran to launch 'advanced centrifuges' in response to IAEA censure
n27424e9463.summary: Iran said it would launch a series of new and advanced centrifuges in response to a resolution adopted by the UN nuclear watchdog that censures Tehran. The announcement was made on Friday.
n27424e9463.why: Iran's nuclear programme and its dispute with the International Atomic Energy Agency affect sanctions risk and oil-market geopolitical premiums in the Middle East.

n5565eefe6d.headline: Japan passes $250 bil. economic package meant to lift wages and spur growth
n5565eefe6d.summary: Japan approved a 39 trillion yen ($250 billion) economic stimulus package on Friday. It is centred on initiatives aimed at boosting household incomes and wages, according to the government.
n5565eefe6d.why: Fiscal stimulus in Japan, the world's fourth-largest economy, affects public debt, corporate earnings and the yen, and is closely watched by global bond and currency investors.

n33c0376615.headline: Rupee rises 6 paise to close at 84.44 against US dollar
n33c0376615.summary: The rupee closed 6 paise higher at 84.44 against the US dollar, trading in a narrow range. Forex traders noted the dollar strengthened overseas while Brent oil continued to rise.
n33c0376615.why: The rupee's level against the dollar affects India's import costs, inflation and foreign investor returns, and it is sensitive to oil prices because India is a large oil importer.

nc213716b86.headline: Unilever Nigeria Shares Jump 28% This Week, Boosting Year-To-Date Gains Above 95%
nc213716b86.summary: Unilever Nigeria shares rose 28% this week, lifting their year-to-date gains above 95%. The report did not state a specific company announcement behind the move.
nc213716b86.why: Unilever Nigeria is the local listed unit of the global consumer goods group Unilever, and its share price reflects investor sentiment toward Nigerian consumer stocks.
nc213716b86.why_moved: Shares rose 28% over the week and are up more than 95% year to date, according to the report. No specific cause is given in the input.

ndfb52194ed.headline: Britain sanctions Angola’s dos Santos, Ukrainian oligarch Firtash in corruption crackdown
ndfb52194ed.summary: Britain has barred Angolan billionaire Isabel dos Santos and Ukrainian oligarch Dmytro Firtash and frozen their UK assets. The measures are part of a corruption crackdown.
ndfb52194ed.why: Sanctions and asset freezes by the UK government affect the ability of listed individuals and their linked companies to use British financial and property markets.

n4ffbf6a2da.headline: CORRECTION - Adani pulls bond as founder charged | IFR
n4ffbf6a2da.summary: Adani has pulled a bond offering after US authorities indicted executives at the Indian conglomerate over bribery claims, according to IFR. The founder has been charged.
n4ffbf6a2da.why: Adani Group is a major Indian conglomerate with listed companies and sizeable dollar debt. Legal action affects its funding access and investor confidence.
n4ffbf6a2da.why_moved: US charges against executives over bribery claims have led the group to withdraw a bond offering. Legal risk and reduced funding access typically weigh on investor sentiment.

n2f07e989eb.headline: IAEA board passes Iran resolution as West pushes Tehran toward talks
n2f07e989eb.summary: The IAEA board passed a resolution on Iran as Western countries push Tehran toward talks. The two sides have long been locked in standoffs, including over uranium traces found at undeclared sites.
n2f07e989eb.why: Iran's nuclear programme and sanctions status influence Middle East geopolitical risk and global oil supply expectations.

n2fadabe3b2.summary: The Mexican peso pulled back on labor market woes and falling retail sales, according to a market report. The data points to a weaker domestic economic outlook.

n4a19f5aa61.summary: U.S. stock index futures slipped on Friday as investors remained cautious ahead of a business activity survey and rising geopolitical tensions between Ukraine and Russia. Wall Street's main indexes were also affected.
n4a19f5aa61.why: The S&P 500 futures track the broad US equity market, and business activity surveys offer early signals on economic momentum.

n788f5f951f.headline: Australia rejects Elon Musk's claim that it plans to control access to the internet

n788f5f951f.why: Social media regulation affects platform operators such as X Corp and the compliance costs and revenue models of digital businesses.

nfd18d1ac46.summary: Advance Auto Parts announced plans to shutter 500 stores. The move comes amid inflation pressures and increased competition from Chinese automakers, according to the report.

n8c58371a64.why: Changes to tax rules for farmers affect agricultural asset values, estate planning and the political outlook for UK government policy.

n329d8667cf.headline: India Q2 GDP: Economic growth likely moderated; should Indian investors be worried? | Stock Market News

n4e5f7dda94.headline: ‘Grave concerns’ over national insurance hike say Senedd members
n4e5f7dda94.summary: Senedd members expressed grave concerns about the impact of the UK Government's national insurance tax increase on GPs, universities and charities in Wales.
